title: aidentyack.com: the background clip plays on the custom domain, and Aiden is the person in every photo

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-23 16:21Z: "bro, this is supposed to be that b roll video" (the Made for the Long Way Home band showed its still). 16:25Z: "Here are a couple pics of Aiden and a demo bracelet. Make sure you show the right person on About. Go through every page and make sure it's all up to standard." 17:08Z: "Use the guy on the motorcycle not Aiden. The Scooter pic was for the about page."

detail: The proxy matcher skipped image extensions only, so on a custom domain a request for a clip in public/ (/sites/aiden-tyack/video/at-the-bench.mp4 and .webm) ran through the proxy, was rewritten into the hosted site and answered 404. The video element kept its poster, so the band showed the still. mp4 and webm now sit beside the image extensions in the matcher. The probe builds the matcher's own first entry from proxy.ts and checks every tracked file under public/sites and public/themes skips the proxy. The kit also showed the design file's stand-in riders as Aiden. They are replaced with his own photos: The Maker band is Aiden hammering a strap at his bench, The Maker story is Aiden on his scooter, and the custom band is a blue studded demo bracelet on a wrist at the bench. The home hero keeps the design file's rider, unnamed (Daniel's call). The probe also fails when a stand-in rider photo is named as Aiden, when one of his own photos is missing, or when the scooter leaves The Maker story.
